Interface Customer

All Known Implementing Classes:
CorporateClient, IndividualClient, OnlineClient
public interface Customer
Represents a customer in the system. Defines the common contract for all customer types, including identity, contact information, pricing strategy, and purchase eligibility.

    • getPricingStrategy

      double getPricingStrategy()
      Returns the per-item price multiplier for this customer. A value of 1.0 means full product price; values below 1.0 represent loyalty discounts (e.g. IndividualClient). Corporate clients return the VAT factor (1.0 or 1.21), which CorporateClient.calculateFinalPrice(Product, double) applies directly to the provider's selling price — not on top of a product VAT calculation. Online clients return 1.0; their order-level shipping surcharge is returned separately by getShippingCost().
      Returns:
      a positive price multiplier

    • canPurchase

      boolean canPurchase(Product product)
      Returns whether this customer is allowed to purchase the given product.

      This method encapsulates customer-type-specific purchase restrictions without requiring the caller to perform instanceof checks. For example, Service products can only be sold to in-store (IndividualClient) customers.

      Parameters:
      product - the product the customer wishes to purchase
      Returns:
      true if this customer type may purchase the given product

    • calculateFinalPrice

      default double calculateFinalPrice(Product product, double sellingPrice)
      Calculates the final price this customer pays for the given product at the given provider selling price, applying any VAT rules, discounts, or special pricing specific to this customer type.

      The default implementation applies the product's own Product.calculatePrice(double) (which includes the product-type-specific VAT) and then multiplies by getPricingStrategy() (e.g. a loyalty discount for individual clients). Client types that bypass product-level VAT entirely (e.g. corporate clients) must override this method.

      Parameters:
      product - the product being purchased
      sellingPrice - the provider's base selling price before any tax
      Returns:
      the final price this customer will be charged

    • getShippingCost

      default double getShippingCost()
      Returns the one-time shipping surcharge added to the cart total for this customer. The default implementation returns 0.0 (no shipping cost). OnlineClient overrides this to compute the distance-based fee.
      Returns:
      the shipping surcharge in euros
